name: remotex
description: Operate remote systems with confirmed profile setup, physical Windows host admission, reusable credential aliases, secure local credential lifecycle tools, bounded execution, verified transfer, VM identity, snapshots, and cooperative leases.

interface.shortDescription: Operate remote systems with bounded execution
interface.longDescription: Use OpenSSH, Remote Desktop, WinRM, govc, vmrun, and isolated Edge with named profiles, local credential aliases, physical-host and VM identity, renewable FIFO leases, verified transfer, and tamper-evident audit records. Web tasks support local human batch/subset approval, bounded clicks and exact field values, scoped business submission, expiry, revocation, and separately approved target readback without exporting credentials or attaching another browser.
